688:t_10:26.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「Are you already all right to move around?」

688:t_10:27.en:
$$エスター$$
「Yeah... Now that I can move my body again, food tastes so, so good.」

688:t_10:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then, $$エスター$$, let us hold your ceremony for joining $c once more.」

688:t_10:31.en:
$$エスター$$
「Wait! I said it without thinking, but this was mind control!」

688:t_10:32.en:
$$トライア$$
「It's all right, $$エスター$$. I installed a bomb in him just in case, and gave $n the detonator.」

688:t_10:34.en:
$$ツィーネ$$
「That's just what I'd expect from you, Doctor. So you didn't trust him after all.」

688:t_10:36.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「He's the only one not under the $$バインドスペル$$'s control. If anything happens, he'll press the switch without hesitation.」

688:t_10:39.en:
$$エスター$$
「There it is, $$おコンさん$$!」

688:t_10:40.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ugh... I shall restrain myself from now on...」

688:t_10:41.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But I will continue celebrating those who become ace pilots!」

688:t_10:42.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You probably won't feel up to it today, but I sincerely look forward to visits from all you ace pilots!」

688:t_10:43.en:
$$エスター$$
「He just won't give up...」

689:t_000:1.en:
$$リーロン$$
「The coordinates on the position sensor still point to the galactic center, but...」

689:t_000:2.en:
$$凱$$
「It's just like that time! When we were transported from the galactic center before!」

689:t_000:4.en:
$$號$$
「No... We came here of our own will.」

689:t_000:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「The world beyond the $$天柱$$ at the galactic center...」

689:t_000:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The universe where the $$御使い$$s dwell... Its name is $$カオス・コスモス$$...」

689:t_000:8.en:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「Wait a second, $$ＡＧ$$. How... do you know this place's name?」

689:t_000:9.en:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Save the discussion for later. They're coming.」

689:t_001:1.en:
$$渓$$
「So this really is the universe where they live!」

689:t_001:3.en:
$$リーロン$$
「We're ready to deploy! $$ノノ$$ and $$ラルク$$ are here too!」

689:t_001:4.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$クロウ$$, $$ランド$$, $$セツコ$$, $n! All of you, deploy! Hurry!」

689:t_002:0.en:
$$ランド$$
「A welcoming party already! What considerate guys!」

689:t_002:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「They even brought out some new faces. It really is a grand welcome.」

689:t_002:2.en:
$$真徒$$
「Keep your mouths shut, inferior species. You'll defile this $$カオス・コスモス$$.」

689:t_002:5.en:
$$真徒$$
「Do you think the Exalted Ones would bother with the likes of you?」

689:t_002:6.en:
$$真徒$$
「It seems disposing of mere $$バアル$$ gave you the wrong idea. Your arrogance is outrageous.」

689:t_002:8.en:
$$真徒$$
「We are the $$真徒$$... The people chosen from every universe.」

689:t_002:9.en:
$$真徒$$
「We are beings promised eternity by the Exalted Ones.」

689:t_002:12.en:
$$真徒$$
「Do not speak that name so carelessly!」

689:t_002:13.en:
$$真徒$$
「We have no desire to talk to you. Our appointed mission is exterminating inferior species.」

689:t_002:15.en:
$$真徒$$
「Chant the word of salvation! Salus!!」

689:t_002:18.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「So they're lapdogs blindly obeying a mighty power.」

689:t_002:19.en:
$$真徒$$
「If you still don't understand your place, we'll make you understand!」

689:t_002:20.en:
$$真徒$$
「Receive the mercy of the Exalted Ones, who permitted us to use this $$ゼル・ビレニウム$$!」

689:t_002:21.en:
$$万丈$$
「$$ゼル・ビレニウム$$... So that's the name of those crystal giants.」

689:t_002:22.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Tch...! It looks like they're a cut above the crystal monsters!」

689:t_002:23.en:
$$真徒$$
「Let me tell you, these aren't all the forces we have.」

689:t_003:0.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「It's the $$アンチスパイラル$$'s army!」

689:t_003:1.en:
$$真徒$$
「That being has already perished. We will make use of its forces.」

689:t_003:2.en:
$$真徒$$
「It would have been better if you were as wise as that being.」

689:t_003:6.en:
$$シモン$$
「You feel it too, $$ブータ$$... What this universe means.」

689:t_003:9.en:
$$トライア$$
「There's nowhere to run. We just have to do it.」

689:t_003:10.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$クロウ$$, $$セツコ$$, $$ランド$$, $n! Head for the points I'm about to designate!」

689:t_004:0.en:
$$セツコ$$
「They're in the middle of the enemy formation...!」

689:t_004:1.en:
$n
「What is the point of going there!?」

689:t_004:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「I'll explain later! Hurry if you don't want to die!」

689:t_004:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「The key to turning this around must be there...!」

689:t_004:5.en:
$$ランド$$
「It looks like we've gotta do it...!」

689:t_004:6.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$セツコ$$, head to the point at two o'clock!」

689:t_005:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$ランド$$, head to the point at four o'clock!」

689:t_006:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$クロウ$$, head to the point at eight o'clock!」
